evidence: In the cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image (Fig. 2, top) the pore walls are seen as white stripes due to edge contrast. The Al2O3 film itself cannot be distinguished with this magnification which was chosen to demonstrate the through-wafer pores. The Al2O3 film thickness on selected points on the pore walls was measured using energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis (Fig. 2 bottom).
